close_reason: Fixed: if .is_some() + .unwrap() refactored to if let Some(exclude_ids)
description: In email_matches_condition (tests/common/mod.rs), the None arm of the borrow-dance match calls .unwrap() on cond.in_mailbox_other_than.as_ref(). This is safe only because the enclosing 'if cond.in_mailbox_other_than.is_some()' guard is in scope, but a reader must trace back to verify correctness. Idiomatic Rust would replace the outer 'if .is_some()' guard with 'if let Some(ids) = &cond.in_mailbox_other_than', then build the HashSet from ids directly, eliminating the unwrap entirely and making the binding's validity self-evident. Alternatively, annotate with .expect("guard guarantees Some") to document the invariant at the call site.
title: email_matches_condition: use if-let instead of is_some guard + unwrap
